riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption is designated due to missing evidence on axis V (viability). We assume that target users are willing to pay for a commercial tool that packages simulation-based parameter estimation workflows.

mvp.text: Conduct customer interviews and a price acceptance test with quantitative researchers to evaluate willingness to pay for simulation-based parameter estimation tools.
mvp.type: customer interviews and price acceptance test

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of 40 percent positive willingness-to-pay responses during customer interviews and price acceptance testing.

kill_criteria.text: Fewer than 15 percent of interviewed target users indicate willingness to pay above the proposed threshold of 50 dollars per month during price acceptance tests.
